label: Count
help: A "this stream" count starts at 0 when a broadcast goes live and survives the source reloading mid-broadcast: it is rebuilt from the app's event history (its most recent 500 events). After the broadcast ends it keeps showing that broadcast's count until the next one starts. Before any broadcast this run it counts from when the source loaded.

label: Facebook
help: Ticked platforms are counted or summed. Follows come from Twitch, Kick and YouTube (as subscribers); subs and raids from Twitch and Kick; gifted subs from Twitch, Kick and YouTube; bits from Twitch; Super Chats and members from YouTube; Kicks from Kick. Facebook reports totals and viewers only.

label: Format
help: {n} is the number, e.g. "YouTube subs today: {n}".

label: Start Offset
help: Added to the count before it is shown, e.g. to carry on from an earlier stream.

label: Idle Text
help: Shown in place of a total or viewer count while none of the ticked platforms reports one. Never shown as 0.

label: Number Animation
help: Plays when a new event or reading changes the number. With the system's reduce-motion setting on, every change is instant.

label: Text
help: Overrides the widget's Font, Font Size and Text Color for this element only. The widget's Background Color and Align still apply — a slot background paints a second box inside the widget's.
